idea: P25 hand core CG2 (the turners are the brake): the gate stops the crate; the gate's two links are the alternating-spinner pusher's turners, so the departures that open the gate turn the pusher away and back - it faces the crate again just as the gate opens; its third neighbour must wait, and the block in column 3 must not push the crate down
family: P25 hybrid: turners are the brake
